methods.name: Operation-family quotient closure and safe-operation census
BRC square-increment finite-difference jet tail
triggers: compose quotient jet with square-gap tables
capabilities: retain exact E=q(2J+q) on each of the five fixed-step mod-8 source orbits
prove the exact third-difference product identity coupling quotient and root jets
prove the sharp common-tail root third-difference interval [-3,387]
reuse the quotient-jet intervals epsilon in [-4,4] and Delta^2 q in [-2,98]
retain the sole unbounded mixed product (Delta q)(Delta^2 J) and transport it using only bounded-coefficient multiplications
after fifteen quotient divisions and fifteen direct square-increment seed products, perform no fresh division and no multiplication of two N-growing operands
preserve exact multiplier root/remainder states with at most two ordinary BRC root corrections
compose unchanged with the BALANCED 4032/12155/12673 square-gap residue cascade
methods.core_law: On one stride-8 source orbit let s=nabla q, a=nabla^2 q, t=nabla J, u=nabla^2 J, e=nabla^3 q_new, w=nabla^3 J_new and E=q(2J+q). Then nabla^3 E_new = e(2(J+q+s+a+t+u+w)+e)+2w(q+s+a)+6(su+a(s+t)). The quotient jet gives e in [-4,4] and a in [-2,98]. For J=floor(sqrt(mN)), the common tail 4m^5>=N gives 0<Delta_8^3 sqrt(mN)<=384; floor phase contributes strictly between -4 and 4, hence w lies in the sharp integer interval [-3,387]. Retaining M=su and updating M_new=M+s w+(a+e)u+(a+e)w means every post-seed product has a fixed bounded integer factor.
methods.hard_boundary: This is an exact multiplier-state execution optimization extending t0.brc_quotient_jet_tail; it does not shorten a Lehman/Hart-style multiplier horizon, change factor-search complexity, establish RSA practicality, or create a new top-level BRC family. Finite CPython timings favor the difference jet only for sufficiently large integers (near parity at 4096 bits and favorable at 8192/16384 bits in the committed run); smaller inputs should retain the fresh native product. The exact quotient remainder, root finite differences, energy finite differences, and mixed provenance coordinate must not be collapsed.

methods.name: Weighted BRC CWM / log-multiplicity calculus
capabilities: exact positive-rational branch recoalescence and propagation through one CWM carrier
effective multiplicity E=W/M and symbolic BRC LN surplus readout
projective future scaling and incoming-weight compensation
one-state multi-loop exact recurrence and stable geometric closure
typed deterministic degeneration with E=1 and zero log surplus
methods.core_law: Positive finite branch systems carry CWM=(C,W,M) with alternative recoalescence (+,+,max) and serial propagation by componentwise multiplication; E=W/M and Delta=ln(E) measure multiplicity beyond the dominant path. Equal k-way recoalescence has Delta=ln k. For one-state loops total mass is stable iff S=sum q_i<1, not merely max q_i<1.
methods.hard_boundary: Positive Weighted-BRC does not represent signed/amplitude cancellation, does not recover erased branch provenance from Boolean support, does not make LN/LOG primitive state, and does not provide a general SCC/Perron-Frobenius/spectral-radius theorem. Deterministic single-path problems reduce to E=1, Delta=0 and should not be artificially reinterpreted as multiplicity problems.

methods.description: Existing published executable for two positive support raw X6 stability certificate: aggregate positive populations, form the Jordan difference, verify all twenty raw marginals, D >= 4*M, and the original-coordinate equal-weight rectangle equality classification. 双正支点、二十张 raw 表、整数不等式与矩形取等的既有可执行证书登记。

X6 双正支点 raw 二十表 稳定性 矩形取等 证书

methods.hard_boundary: This source-only candidate registers an already published bounded consumer. It adds no theorem, family, formal Result, Working Truth, or main admission. methods.name: Exact quotient-root atlas and ternary state-count carry operator
capabilities: compute the exact state-specific coalescence horizon and high-denominator cutoff
certify the high injective chart and contiguous forced low-root chart
compute exact distinct quotient-root state cardinality without a full denominator scan
certify the unique optional horizon state by a binary boundary carry
compress the exact count to a three-valued threshold carry
materialize the compressed root-state atlas for regression or downstream finite reasoning
methods.core_law: For n>=1 and r>=1, with H=R_(r+1)(r*n-1) and D=floor(n/(H+1)^r), the quotient-root atlas R_r(floor(n/d)), 1<=d<=n, is the disjoint union of an injective D-state high chart and the forced low interval 1..H-1 plus at most the horizon H. Hence |S|+1=D+H+kappa; with q=floor(H/r) the three-point D-band compresses this to |S|+1=H+q+tau with tau in {0,1,2} selected by two exact thresholds.
methods.hard_boundary: DOMAIN_OPERATOR only. The carrier is the finite positive-denominator quotient-root atlas. Do not generalize to arbitrary floor maps or quotient semigroups, do not infer prime/factoring/Legendre or continuum claims, do not erase the H=0 branch, and do not treat the ternary state-count carry as a universal T5 carry law. No Foundation mutation follows.

methods.name: BRC square-increment scaled cross-coordinate jet
capabilities: bijectively replace the older mixed coordinate M using already-retained quotient/root finite differences
evaluate the exact square-increment third difference as e*(2*(J_new+q_new)-e)+2*w*(q_new-e)+C
transport C exactly with only bounded-coefficient big-integer multiplications
preserve the existing quotient-third, root-third and two-root-correction proof bounds
preserve the exact fifteen quotient divisions and fifteen square-increment product seed budget
match the existing square-increment difference scanner state-for-state
compose unchanged with the BALANCED square-gap residue cascade
methods.core_law: Let s=nabla q, a=nabla^2 q, t=nabla J, u=nabla^2 J, e=nabla^3 q_new, w=nabla^3 J_new and M=s*u. Define C=6*(M+a*(s+t)). Because a,s,t are already retained, M=C/6-a*(s+t), so this is an observer-equivalent coordinate change. At the target point, nabla^3 E_new=e*(2*(J_new+q_new)-e)+2*w*(q_new-e)+C. With a_new=a+e and u_new=u+w, C_new=C+6*s*w+6*e*(s+t)+6*a_new*(2*u_new+a_new). The new multipliers are bounded by the inherited e in [-4,4], w in [-3,387] and a_new in [-2,98] bounds.
methods.hard_boundary: This is a compatible constant-factor execution variant extending t0.brc_square_increment_difference_jet, not a new top-level BRC family. It does not reduce the multiplier search horizon or factorization complexity. Finite CPython reference timings show a modest roughly 2.6%-13.8% gain across the tested 1024..16384-bit cohorts; these timings are environment-dependent and not an asymptotic machine theorem. Exact square-gap residue-state transport and a 2-adic front gate were also tested but not promoted because their end-to-end gain was marginal after the energy jet became the dominant cost.
